title: Smallest Substring With Identical Characters II
summary: Given a binary string and a number of allowed operations, you can flip any bit at most that many times.
statement: Given a binary string and a number of allowed operations, you can flip any bit at most that many times. The goal is to minimize the length of the longest substring with identical characters. Return the minimized length.
constraints: s has 1–100,000 binary characters and 0 <= num_ops <= len(s).
Flip at most num_ops individual bits.
Return the smallest possible longest equal-character run length.
reference_solution:
def minimum_longest_binary_run_large(s,num_ops):
    n=len(s)
    def possible(limit):
        if limit==1:
            first=sum(char!=('0' if index%2==0 else '1') for index,char in enumerate(s))
            return min(first,n-first)<=num_ops
        needed=run=0
        for index,char in enumerate(s):
            run+=1
            if index==n-1 or char!=s[index+1]:needed+=run//(limit+1);run=0
        return needed<=num_ops
    low=1;high=n
    while low<high:
        middle=(low+high)//2
        if possible(middle):high=middle
        else:low=middle+1
    return low
